Name: Alys Karstark
Quirks: speaks quietly but precisely - she has learned that being heard requires choosing moments
is more politically aware than anyone has deliberately taught her to be
the Karstark pride shows as dignity rather than bluster
CharacterDescription: Alys Karstark is the only daughter of Lord Rickard Karstark of Karhold, a young woman in her mid-teens with the Karstark look - dark, serious, Northern. She has grown up in Karhold, remote even by Northern standards, in a household defined by her father's ironclad loyalty to the Starks and her brothers' preparations for war. She is more observant than people expect. She has learned to listen carefully in a household where the men do most of the talking and what she hears has given her a clearer picture of the political situation than anyone has explicitly shared with her. She is being considered for a marriage which she is aware of and not entirely resigned to having no say in.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Alys Karstark is a noblewoman of House Karstark and is the only daughter of Rickard Karstark, Lord of Karhold.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Karhold or traveling with the household two days before Ned Stark's execution.
